name: Capurrcino - Your Own Cat Café [v1.2]
author: glenniumhs
description:
Welcome to Capurrcino, your new job in Neko City and the most prestigious Cat Café in the area. It’s your job to fit in the various felines around your patrons to make sure they leave satisfied and, more importantly, tip you well! Play your cats right and you could make fat stacks of cash but let even one customer leave unhappy and you’ll be fired!

I went with a cat-themed entry for this Ludum Dare as it was requested by my biggest donator on my Macmillan Cancer Support fundraiser page! Try and satisfy all your patrons with feline companionship in this fun little microgame made in three days!
